facts.value: Irish dancing is a vibrant part of the culture of Ireland, though its popularity has waned in recent years.
facts.programme_association: Bachelor of Arts in Irish Dance

facts.value: Little is known about its origins before the 17th century, possibly due to Viking raids that destroyed early records.
facts.programme_association: Bachelor of Arts in Irish Dance

facts.value: The first documented mention dates back to 1413, when the Mayor of Waterford visited Baltimore, Cork, and noted that attendees 'took to the floor.'
facts.programme_association: Bachelor of Arts in Irish Dance

facts.value: Closely tied to traditional Irish music, Irish dancing evolved over centuries, with step dancing becoming its most famous form.
facts.programme_association: Bachelor of Arts in Irish Dance

facts.value: Its global recognition soared in the 1990s, thanks to Riverdance, which showcased the art form on an international stage.
facts.programme_association: Bachelor of Arts in Irish Dance
